title.value: Adjusting Machine Learning Decisions for Equal Opportunity and Counterfactual Fairness
title.justification: The paper focuses on adjusting machine learning decisions to ensure fairness in terms of equal opportunity and counterfactual fairness.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose two algorithms that adjust fitted ML predictors to produce decisions that are fair. Our methods provide post-hoc adjustments to the predictors, without requiring that they be retrained.

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development of two algorithms to adjust machine learning decisions to ensure fairness. The algorithms focus on maintaining equal counterfactual opportunity and counterfactual fairness in high-stakes decisions such as admissions, income, credit, and recidivism. The methods allow post-hoc adjustments to machine learning models to adhere to fairness criteria without retraining the models.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with fairness in machine learning algorithms, which does not directly align with any of the pre-defined eco-responsible categories related to climate or environmental sustainability.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose two algorithms that adjust fitted ML predictors to produce decisions that are fair. Our methods provide post-hoc adjustments to the predictors, without requiring that they be retrained.
